entries.title: Titus 2:1
segments: But you speak [the] things which become sound doctrine:

entries.title: Titus 2:2
segments: aged men to be temperate, sensible, discreet, sound in faith, in love, in patience.

entries.title: Titus 2:3
segments: Let the aged women likewise [be] in reverent behavior, not slanderers, not enslaved by much wine, teachers of good;

entries.title: Titus 2:4
segments: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

entries.title: Titus 2:5
segments: [to be] discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, subject to [their] own husbands, that the Word of God may not be blasphemed.

entries.title: Titus 2:6
segments: Likewise exhort the young men to be discreet;

entries.title: Titus 2:7
segments: In all things having shown yourself a pattern of good works: in doctrine, purity, sensibleness, without corruption,

entries.title: Titus 2:8
segments: [in] sound speech that cannot be condemned, that he who is opposed may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

entries.title: Titus 2:9
segments: Slaves [are] to be obedient to [their] masters, to please them well in all [things], not talking back,

entries.title: Titus 2:10
segments: not stealing, but showing all good faith, so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.

entries.title: Titus 2:11
segments: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

entries.title: Titus 2:12
segments: teaching us that having denied ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live discreetly, righteously and godly, in this present world,

entries.title: Titus 2:13
segments: looking for the blessed hope, and the glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Titus 2:14
segments: who gave Himself for us that He might redeem us from all iniquity and purify to Himself a special people, zealous of good works.

entries.title: Titus 2:15
segments: Speak these things, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
